title: Confess with Your Mouth
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: Is it that simple? Yes. But it is not a magic formula. It is genuine belief and a total commitment to Jesus as Lord, and he gives us everything in return.
exhortation: Could it really be that simple? Just believe and say the words? The short answer is yes. But know this: when it says to believe in your heart, you must actually believe. God sees directly into your heart and mine, and he knows whether every confession is genuine.

This isn't a magic incantation where you say the right words in the right order and you're good to go. It is a genuine understanding that you are a sinner in need of a Savior, and a radical commitment to serving Jesus as Lord and King. It's like dying: dying to your plans, your ideas and your vices. Your very life no longer belongs to you, but to him. Jesus says in Matthew, "Whoever loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me, and whoever loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me." This is a total commitment to Jesus.

Why do that, you might ask? Here's something else Jesus says in Matthew: "For whoever would save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for my sake will find it." Jesus isn't taking everything and giving nothing. He is saving you from a life that leads to destruction and trading it for a life of everlasting joy. He gives you what you always wanted and could never get from anything but him. So I say again: today is the day to believe in Jesus, confess your sin, and receive him as your Lord, Savior and King.
prayer: Lord, we believe. We believe you are God the Father, God the Son and God the Holy Spirit, three in one. We believe you died and rose again, and we believe in eternal life and the life to come. For those who are struggling, help their unbelief. If anyone listening has not put their trust fully in you, may they believe and confess with their mouth that Jesus is Lord. You are faithful and just to forgive.

Thank you for so great a salvation, and for the chance to rehearse it, remember it and praise you for it every day. May it be on our lips today. Give us divine appointments to share this great news with others, so that your name is magnified in all the earth. Thank you, Jesus.
